package.name: adaptive_pid_ros2
package.description: ROS2 Humble node graph for online adaptive PID gain scheduling: plant, reference, PID controller, RL agent, disturbance, logging, and visualization nodes. Reuses the same InvertedPendulumPlant/PIDController implementation as the training environment (see the adaptive_pid Python package, installed separately via pip) so sim and ROS2 physics never diverge -- see docs/architecture.md.
